page.layout: One block: a centred title page, all lines in the middle of the page, no running head, no page number. The "Digitized by Google" stamp at lower right is excluded.
page.notes: The first line is in italic capitals, with the first word set in a swash-like form; "SIXTINI AMAMA" is read as printed. "CVM" is in spaced capitals. "Tetragrammato." and "Ad argumenta" have italic or mixed-case type as printed. "JEHOVAH" is in spaced capitals within the line. Small stray marks on the page are specks and are not transcribed.
